newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated Dec 24.

-- Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet says public opinion supports strong franc policy, expects medium-term growth to average 2.5 percent to 3.0 percent and adds the Bank of France is happy about the lira's pivot rate. He foresees no tension over parities.
-- Shareholders force Schneider to focus on core activity by spinning off Spie Batignolles to Britain's Amec and opening talks with Siemens on high-tension electrical activities.

-- Matra Espace-Defense chairman Noel Forgeard argues for electronics merger with Thomson-CSF, adding that a Thomson sale to Aerospatiale-Dassault would lead to rival link-ups such as between British Aerospace and GEC or Dasa and Siemens. Such link-ups would be to France's disadvantage, he said.
-- Metaleurop, the world's second largest lead producer, will boost registered capital by 600 million francs.
